messages.subject: pathological parse error
parts:
No sure if this has been reported already.  Admittedly rare R syntax can give knitr indigestion,

```{r}
paste("a",
# some comment
"b")
```

Results in,

label: unnamed-chunk-1
Warning in block_exec(params) :
  failed to tidy R code in chunk <unnamed-chunk-1>
reason: Error in base::parse(text = code, srcfile = NULL) : 
  3:1: unexpected string constant
2: invisible(".BeGiN_TiDy_IdEnTiFiEr_HaHaHa# some comment.HaHaHa_EnD_TiDy_IdEnTiFiEr")
3: "b"
   ^

Don't comment out parameters this way and all is well.

- Chris Warth

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] pathological parse error
parts:
Please use the chunk option ```{r tidy=FALSE} for that chunk. It is a
problem of the formatR package. In the next version of knitr, the tidy
option will default to FALSE.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
